visible_part: A low grassed mound with a dozen loose stone blocks (some look like column bases with a socket) on the site of 九洲清晏殿, a stone-flag path in front, the Back Lake 后湖 behind with willows and pines; no foundation outline is legible

note: Best present picture of a Fuhai quay: course heights and the step in the waterfront can be read; the quay may be partly re-set. Viewed in the repo copy.
